book.name: Mɑteu
book.title: LABAARI GEA NGE MƐ MATEU U YORUA

content: I kun dɑ n tɔmbu sirimɔ
Yesu u nɛɛ, i kun tɔmbu sirimɔ bɑɑdommɑ, Gusunɔ u ǹ mɑɑ kɑ bɛɛ sirimɔ.
Domi nɡe mɛ i ɡɑbu sirimɔ, nɡe mɛyɑ Gusunɔ u koo mɑɑ bɛɛ siri. Mɑ sɑkɑku ɡe i kɑ ɡɑbu yĩiruɑmmɛ, ɡeyɑ bɑ koo kɑ bɛɛ yĩiruɑ.
Mbɑn sɔ̃nɑ ɑ yɑkɔ mɛɛrimɔ wunɛn kpɑɑsin nɔnu sɔɔ mɑ ɑ ǹ dɑ̃ɑ bĩiru lɑɑkɑri mɔ̀ te tɑ wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn tiin nɔnuɔ.
Amɔnɑ kɑɑ kɑ kpĩ ɑ wunɛn kpɑɑsi sɔ̃ u de ɑ yɑkɔ wunɑ win nɔnun di sɑnɑm mɛ ɑ dɑ̃ɑ bĩiru mɔ wunɛn tiin nɔnuɔ.
Murɑfiti wunɛ, ɑ ɡbiiyo ɑ dɑ̃ɑ bĩi te wunɑ wunɛn tiin nɔnun di kpɑ ɑ yɑm wɑ sɑ̃ɑ sɑ̃ɑ ɑ kɑ yɑkɔ wunɑ wunɛn kpɑɑsin nɔnun di.
I ku ɡɑ̃ɑ dɛɛrɑnu bɔ̃nu wɛ̃ nu ku kɑ ɡɔsirɑ nu bɛɛ mɔnsimɑ. I ku mɑɑ bɛɛn ɡoo ɡobiɡinu kɔ̃ kurusɔnun suunu sɔɔ. Su koo nu tɑɑku.
Kɑnɑrun ɡɑri
Yesu u nɛɛ, i n dɑ bikie, i ko wɑ i mwɑ. I n dɑ kɑsu, i ko wɑ. I n dɑ ɡɑmbo so, bɑ koo bɛɛ kɛniɑ.
Domi bɑɑwure wi u bikiɑmɔ bɑ koo nùn wɛ̃. Wi u kɑsu u koo wɑ. Wi u mɑɑ ɡɑmbo soomɔ bɑ koo yɛ̃ro kɛniɑ.
Durɔ wɑrɑ bɛɛ sɔɔ, win bii ù n nùn pɛ̃ɛ bikiɑ u koo wurɑ u nùn kperu wɛ̃.
Ǹ kun mɛ ù n nùn swɑ̃ɑ bikiɑ u koo nùn wɑɑ wɛ̃?
Bɛɛ be i sɑ̃ɑ tɔn kɔ̃sobu mɑ i yɛ̃ mɑ bɑ rɑ bibu kɛ̃ɛ ɡeenu wɛ̃, bɛɛn Bɑɑbɑ wɔlluɡii u ǹ koo be bɑ nùn kɑnɑmɔ ɡɑ̃ɑ ɡeenu wɛ̃ n bɛɛ kere?
Yen sɔ̃nɑ ye i kĩ tɔmbu bu bɛɛ kuɑ i bu kuo mɛ bɛɛn tii, domi yeniwɑ Mɔwisin woodɑn tireru kɑ Gusunɔn sɔmɔbun sɔ̃ɔsibun tubusiɑnu.
Kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ ǹ yɑsu
Yesu u nɛɛ, i duo kɑ kɔnnɔ ɡe ɡɑ ǹ yɑsu, domi swɑɑ ye yɑ dɔɔ kɑm koo yerɔ yɑ ǹ bɑɑsinɑɑ mɔ, yen kɔnnɔ ɡɑ mɑɑ yɑsu mɑ tɔn dɑbinu dumɔ mi.
Adɑmɑ swɑɑ ye yɑ dɔɔ wɑ̃ɑru sɔɔ yɑ sɛ̃, yen kɔnnɔ ɡɑ ǹ yɑsu. Bɑ ǹ mɑɑ dɑbi be bɑ ɡe wɑɑmɔ.
Dɑ̃ru kɑ ten binu
Yesu u mɑɑ nɛɛ, i lɑɑkɑri koowo kɑ sɔmɔ weesuɡibu. Yɑ̃ɑ ɡɔnɑ bɑ rɑ n tii pote, bu kɑ nɑ bɛɛn mi, ɑdɑmɑ sɔɔwɔ bɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ nɡe dɛmɑkunu ni nu kɑsu nu ɡo nu tem.
I ko bu ɡiɑ sɑɑ ben kookoosun di nɡe mɛ bɑ rɑ dɑ̃ru ɡie sɑɑ ten binun di. Bɑ rɑ berenu sɔri ɑwĩi wɔllɔ? Bɑ koo ɡɑndun binu sɔri sɑ̃kɑ wɔllɔ?
Dɑ̃ɑ ɡeerɑ tɑ rɑ bii ɡeenu mɑ, kpɑ dɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃suru tu bii kɔ̃sunu mɑ.
Dɑ̃ɑ ɡeeru tɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ tu bii kɔ̃sunu mɑ, mɛyɑ mɑɑ dɑ̃ɑ kɔ̃suru tɑ ǹ kpɛ̃ tu bii ɡeenu mɑ.
Dɑ̃ru bɑɑtere te tɑ ǹ bii ɡeenu mɑrumɔ bɑ rɑ tu burewɑ bu kɔ̃ dɔ̃ɔ sɔɔ.
Nɡe mɛyɑ i ko kɑ sɔmɔ weesuɡii be ɡiɑ sɑɑ ben kookoosun di.
Nɑ ǹ bɛɛ yɛ̃ ɡɑm
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, n ǹ mɔ bɑɑwure wi u mɑn sokumɔ Yinni, Yinni, wiyɑ u koo du mi Gusunɔ u bɑndu swĩi, mɑ n kun mɔ wi u nɛn Bɑɑbɑ wi u wɑ̃ɑ wɔllɔn kĩru mɔ̀.
Tɔ̃ɔ te, tɑ̀ n tunumɑ, tɔn dɑbirɑ tɑ koo mɑn sɔ̃ tu nɛɛ, Yinni, Yinni sɑ ǹ ɡɑri ɡeruɑ kɑ wunɛn yĩsiru? Sɑ ǹ wɛrɛkunu ɡire kɑ wunɛn yĩsiru? Sɑ ǹ mɑɑ sɔm dɑmɡii dɑbinu kue kɑ wunɛn yĩsiru?
Sɑnɑm mɛyɑ kon bu sɔ̃ bɑtumɑ sɔɔ n nɛɛ, nɑ ǹ bɛɛ yɛ̃ ɡɑm, i doonɔ nɛn min di, bɛɛ be i kɔ̃sɑ mɔ̀.
Bɑnɔbu yiru
Yesu mɑɑ nɛɛ, yen sɔ̃, bɑɑwure wi u nɛn ɡɑri yini nɔɔmɔ, mɑ u yi mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ, u ko n kɑ durɔ bwisiɡii wini weenɛ wi u win diru bɑnɑ kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ.
Gurɑ yɑ nɑ, dɑɑnu yibɑ mɑ nim tɛriɑ mɑ woo ɡɑ dii te swee. Adɑmɑ tɑ ǹ wɔrumɛ yèn sɔ̃ bɑ te bɑnɑ kpee sɑɑrɑ wɔllɔ.
Adɑmɑ bɑɑwure wi u nɛn ɡɑri yini nɔɔmɔ mɑ u ǹ yi mɛm nɔɔwɑmmɛ, u ko n kɑ durɔ ɡɑri bɔkɔ wini weenɛ wi u win diru bɑnɑ yɑni sɛɛri wɔllɔ.
Gurɑ yɑ nɑ, dɑɑnu nu yibɑ mɑ nim tɛriɑ mɑ woo ɡɑ dii te swee, mɑ tɑ wɔrumɑ. Mɑ ten wɔrumɑɑ kpɛ̃ɑ.
Yesun yiiko
Ye Yesu u yeni ɡeruɑ u kpɑ, tɔn wɔru ɡe, ɡɑ biti kuɑ win sɔ̃ɔsibun sɔ̃.
Domi u bu sɔ̃ɔsimɔwɑ nɡe wi u yiiko mɔ, n ǹ mɔ nɡe ben woodɑ yɛ̃robu.
